verdict.rationale: Devin can be customized for specialized work through Knowledge, a set of instructions it references in every session, and through AGENTS.md support. Playbooks are also mentioned, though only as something the MCP server exposes. The evidence never documents a dedicated custom-skills mechanism for Devin itself; the 'plugin and skill' mention refers to Devin Handoff for other agents. Missing for 10: an explicit custom-skill/plugin system for Devin, documentation of how playbooks define reusable specialized tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
